rows.quote: GWAS summary statistics of HOMA-IR, ISI, and Fins were obtained from the Meta-Analyses of Glucose and Insulin-related traits Consortium including 37,037, 53,710, and 151,013 non-diabetic European participants, respectively4–6, and GWAS summary statistics of TG:HDL-C were obtained from the UK Biobank with 402,398 European participants7 (Supplementary Data 1).
rows.reference_quote: Chen, J. et al. The trans-ancestral genomic architecture of glycemic traits. Nat. Genet. 53 , 840–860 (2021).
rows.coder_note: Step 2 (rules I2, C5): the sentence under outcome_2:p002 names the MAGIC consortium in full and attributes its HOMA-IR, ISI and Fins data to references 4-6; reference 6 (Chen 2021, doi 10.1038/s41588-021-00852-9) is the source of exactly one dictionary row. For adjudication: the same group cites reference 4 (Dupuis 2010, doi 10.1038/ng.520) and an unlisted reference 5, which are other MAGIC publications with no dictionary row; by the order of traits Chen 2021 is the Fins source only. They identify no other dictionary row, so step 1 was not applied.

rows.quote: The GWAS data for TG:HDL-C can be available at the GWAS Catalog (https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gwas/summary_statistics/GCST90295001-GCST90296000/GCST90295949/).
rows.coder_note: Step 3 (rules B, I2, C4 third case): this row's dataset is the TG:HDL-C GWAS in the UK Biobank (p002, 402,398 Europeans, reference 7 Oliveri 2024, whose DOI is no dictionary row's); the data-availability sentence under outcome_1:p001 gives its GWAS Catalog accession GCST90295949, which no dictionary row lists by prefix, range or identifier. Sentence occurs twice in the source; pinned with the helper. The other passages (1000 Genomes, AstraZeneca PheWAS portal) do not concern this dataset.
